lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  apply (inner_self_eq_zero' (𝕜 := ℝ)).mp
  by_contra hx
  have hc := hf.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x₀) continuous_const

    ((isOpen_lt continuous_const hc).mem_nhds (real_inner_self_nonneg'.lt_of_ne' hx))
  exact ((hsm.continuous.fun_mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    hcomp.mul_right
    (fun x => le_of_not_gt fun h =>
      (hs (subset_tsupport φ (left_ne_zero_of_mul h.ne))).asymm
        (neg_of_mul_neg_right h (hnn (Set.mem_range_self x)).1))
    (mul_ne_zero (hxφ.trans_ne one_ne_zero) hx)).ne' (by
    simpa only [inner_smul_right'] using hg _ (IsTestFunction.smul_right
      ⟨hsm, hcomp⟩ contDiff_const))

      (f := f) (by intro; simp only [f, mem_Icc, Prod.mk_le_mk, hB, and_self])

  induction hn

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs := fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (c := 𝓕.c) (i := j)
    (n := 2) (hA.of_le $ right_eq_inf.mp rfl) t
  have hEd := fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBcd := fun j => magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (c := 𝓕.c) A
    (n := 2) (hA.of_le $ right_eq_inf.mp rfl) (j, i)
  have hB := fun j => Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (i := j) (hBcd j) t x
  simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out)),
    fun j => Space.fun_deriv_sub (u := j) _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i),
    fun j => Space.deriv_commute (u := j) (v := i) _ (hEs j)] at hB
  have hd := congrArg (fun f => fderiv ℝ f x (Space.basis i))
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  unfold Space.div at hd
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv,
    fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
      (hJ.differentiable $ by decide) t x),
    fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => hEd j j x),
    _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at hd

    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out) x), time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [Time.deriv_eq,
      (((HasFDerivAt.fun_sum
        (fun j _ => (Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hBcd j) x t).hasFDerivAt)).const_mul _).fun_sub
          ((LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
            (hJ.differentiable $ by decide) x i t).hasFDerivAt.const_mul _)).fderiv]
    simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      ← Time.deriv_eq, hB, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [hd, mul_sub]
  simp only [FreeSpace.c_sq, ← div_div, div_mul_cancel₀ _ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]

theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have H a b h := ((hrelation a b).mp h).2
  rw [hdigits_to_num] at H
  simp only [← congrFun hdigits_to_num, ite_mul, Finset.sum_ite, Finset.filter_eq',
    Finset.mem_univ, if_true, Finset.sum_singleton, Finset.filter_ne',
    Finset.sum_erase_eq_sub] at H
  have A := H d e h.1
  have S := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => A i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_fin,
    ← congrFun hdigits_to_num] at S
  intro i
  have C : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 := by decide
  apply (C.pow_right (n := i.1)).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  refine dvd_trans (dvd_sub (dvd_sub (dvd_sub S (dvd_mul_right 7 (digits_to_num d))) (A i)) (H e f h.2 i)) (dvd_of_eq ?_)
  ring1

theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have := InitStatesLength hi
  refine exists_eq_left.2 ⟨updatedStatesInit this
    (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu) (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  have := UpdateStatesLength hu
  simp [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu, updatedStates]
  rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
  exact updatedStatesUpdate this
    (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
  simp_all [List.unzip_zip]
  intro k hk hk'
  simpa [InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk'] using UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let S := (fun g : BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩ => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.val).ncard) '' Set.univ
  obtain ⟨⟨g, hgm⟩, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (show S.Nonempty from
    Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  let B := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  have hb := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ
    (show 2 * sInf S < _ from WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt))
  simp only [← hg, Nat.sub_mul, Nat.sub_add_eq,
    Nat.pow_sub_mul_pow _ (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le'
      (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ..))),
    Nat.pow_sub_mul_pow _ (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps), mul_assoc] at hb
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g hgm) bot_le)
  apply WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr
  apply Nat.lt_succ_of_le
  refine le_trans ?_ hb
  apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2
  rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card B B.toFinite, ← Finset.card_fin (2 ^ steps)]
  refine (Finset.card_le_card ?_).trans (Finset.card_image₂_le (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, i.isLt.trans (lt_of_add_right_lt h_ℓ_add_R_rate)⟩
    steps (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)) B.toFinite.toFinset Finset.univ)
  intro x hx
  exact Finset.mem_image₂.mpr ⟨_,
    B.toFinite.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩,
    _, Finset.mem_univ _,
    (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩
